sections.title: What Is Cyber Security for London SMEs?
text: Cyber security for SMEs is the process of protecting business systems, networks, and data from cyber threats. For organisations operating in London, cyber security is no longer optional it is a critical requirement for protecting sensitive data, maintaining compliance, and ensuring business continuity.

London IT delivers cyber security services for SMEs in London, combining essential protections such as firewalls, antivirus software, encryption, and access controls with a proactive, managed approach. This ensures your business stays secure as threats evolve and technology changes.

blocks.h: Understanding Cyber Security Threats Facing London Businesses

blocks.p: As London SMEs rely more heavily on cloud services, remote working, and digital communication, the risk of cyber attacks continues to increase. Common threats include phishing, ransomware, malware, and data breaches, all of which can disrupt operations and damage reputation.

Cyber security focuses on protecting your networks, devices, and business data from unauthorised access, misuse, or loss. By working with a trusted cyber security provider in London, SMEs can reduce risk, minimise downtime, and stay resilient in an increasingly hostile digital environment.

sections.title: What Is Cyber Essentials for SMEs?
text: Cyber Essentials is a UK government-backed cyber security certification designed to help SMEs protect against the most common cyber threats. It provides a recognised baseline of cyber security suitable for organisations of all sizes.

The scheme focuses on five key security controls which, when correctly implemented, can prevent around 80% of common cyber attacks . For many London SMEs, Cyber Essentials certification is essential for compliance, securing contracts, and working with larger organisations or public-sector bodies.

London IT supports SMEs with Cyber Essentials certification in London , helping businesses meet requirements, improve security posture, and demonstrate a clear commitment to cyber security best practice.

blocks.p: Cyber Essentials is the UK government-backed cyber security certification that proves your business is protected against common cyber threats. For London SMEs, it’s no longer just a “nice to have” it’s often a commercial and compliance requirement.

By implementing the five essential security controls, Cyber Essentials can prevent up to 80% of common cyber attacks. London IT helps SMEs achieve Cyber Essentials certification in London quickly, efficiently, and with minimal disruption to day-to-day operations.

ASSESSMENT REQUIREMENTS:

sections.title: Cyber Essentials Certification for London SMEs
text: Over 80% of UK businesses are exposed to preventable cyber security risks. That’s why Cyber Essentials has become the baseline cyber security standard for organisations across the UK. It provides a proven framework to protect against common cyber threats and demonstrate compliance.

London IT makes Cyber Essentials certification in London straightforward. The process is simpler than many businesses expect and focuses on five essential technical controls that significantly reduce cyber risk.
As a London-based cyber security provider, we guide you through every step: Identifying gaps, implementing controls, and ensuring your organisation meets certification requirements efficiently.
The Five Cyber Essentials Controls Cyber Essentials focuses on the following core areas:

ul: Access Control – Ensuring only authorised users can access systems and data
Firewalls & Routers – Protecting networks from unauthorised access
Malware Protection – Defending against viruses, ransomware, and malicious software
Secure Configuration – Removing unnecessary services and default settings
Software Updates – Keeping systems patched against known vulnerabilities

blocks.p: Together, these controls protect against the most common cyber attacks including phishing, malware, and unauthorised access. Get Cyber Essentials certified with confidence.
